about: rasya-taste-v4 button library: the looks a page sets on <html data-buttons>, dealt by scripts/buttons.mjs. 'library' looks live in assets/buttons/buttons-library.css (needsJs: also buttons-library.js); 'upstream' looks live in system.css and need no extra file. Rules: references/buttons.md. pages: software (saas, ai, apps, developer tools, fintech; gaming counts here), product (hardware too), service, place, editorial. mood: calm, crisp, playful, editorial. nav and close: the dealt nav and close types (sections.md) the look sits well in.

library.name: fill wipe
library.primary: solid; a deeper tone of the action wipes in from the left and leaves to the right
library.secondary: outline; the ink wipes in from the left and the label flips to the ground colour

library.name: label roll
library.primary: solid; the label slides up and an identical copy rolls in from below
library.secondary: tonal (ink 7% on the ground), the same roll
library.reduced: the label stays; the fill changes tone
from: Text Fall Button (Pace UI), without its elastic overshoot

library.name: arrow swap
library.primary: solid with a drawn arrow; on hover the arrow leaves to the right and comes back in from the left
library.secondary: outline with the same arrow and swap
library.reduced: the arrow stays; the fill or outline changes tone
from: Morphing Arrow Button (arunachalam), the arrow shift only

library.name: key chip
library.primary: solid with a key chip after the label (return by default, data-kbd for a wired shortcut); the chip sinks 1px on hover
library.secondary: outline with a key's 2px lower edge; a press flips the edge to the top
library.reduced: the chip's edge strengthens; nothing moves
library.extras: data-kbd="⌘K" on the primary, only for a shortcut the page wires itself

library.name: ring
library.primary: solid; a hairline ring in the action colour settles 4px around it
library.secondary: outline; its line darkens and a second ink hairline settles around it
library.reduced: the ring shows in place (a colour change)
from: Entry Ring Button (ham7a311), without the gradient or the pointer-entry point

library.name: press depth
library.radius: own: the page's, capped at 10px (a key, never a pill)
library.primary: solid key: a 2px lower edge and a 1px top light; hover raises the edge, a press flips it to the top (letterpress)
library.secondary: outline key with the same edge
library.reduced: the edges change, nothing moves (inset edges are not motion)
from: rasya-taste-v2 B6, without its hard outer shadow

library.name: underline draw
library.primary: solid; a 1px line in the label's colour draws under the words
library.secondary: a text button at the button's height: a hairline under the words, the ink line draws in from the left and leaves to the right
library.link: words: .link without its arrow, the same drawn line

library.name: icon reveal
library.primary: solid; a dot after the label grows into a disc in the label's colour with the arrow cut out of it
library.secondary: outline; the same dot and disc in ink
library.reduced: the disc shows at rest; hover changes the colour only
from: Interactive Hover Button (Magic UI), the dot that grows

library.name: shine
library.primary: solid; one soft band of light crosses it once as the pointer arrives (700 ms), never looping
library.reduced: no band; the fill changes tone
library.needsRuleChange: motion.md bans a shine sweep on hover (HANDOFF-E.md)
from: Shiny Button (Magic UI), as one pass instead of a loop

library.name: magnetic
library.primary: solid; leans up to 4px toward a fine pointer and eases back
library.reduced: no lean; the kit's colour hover
library.needsRuleChange: motion.md bans a magnetic button; dealt only with --allow magnetic (HANDOFF-E.md)
from: Get Started Button (marcellinleclercq), its pointer-following idea, much smaller

library.name: split
library.primary: solid; a hairline rule and a meta cell after the label (an arrow, or data-meta); hover draws the rule taller and nudges the cell 3px
library.secondary: outline with the same rule and cell
library.extras: data-meta="Free" | "$169" | "4.2k" on a button: decoration, so the fact is in the page's text too

library.name: tonal soft
library.primary: solid with a 1px light along its top edge
library.secondary: a soft tint of the action colour (12%), the label in ink; hover deepens the tint and shows an inset ring in the action colour
